reviewer_note: NO CHANGE: the township-vs-village collision resolves in favour of the township, so the existing geography is already correct and the FBI service population is the stale figure. Gaines Township (Genesee County) disbanded its one-officer department in March 2013, voters passed a 0.5-mill police millage in November 2013, and the township re-established a two-officer department; the SEPARATE Village of Gaines police department was dissolved by village council on 2017-03-09 (its patrol car was sold to the township), so since 2017 the township department covers the whole township INCLUDING the village. Michigan villages remain part of their township and Gaines village is not a separate jurisdiction in this build, so the township pop20 of 6,664 already includes the village's 377 residents and is the right denominator. The 373 FBI service population is almost exactly the 2020 village count (377) and is best read as a village-era figure carried forward, not as evidence that the department only covers the village; the flagged 17.9x dilution is a service-population artefact, not a geography error. Do not confuse this township with Gaines Charter Township in Kent County, which contracts with the Kent County Sheriff.

Albee township (cousub 2614500920, pop20 2,046) is ALREADY carried by its own ORI MI7392900 (ALBEE TWP PD BURT, service pop 2,033) in jurisdiction_master. agency_master: county_fips=145, place_fips=70520 (Saginaw city), crosswalk_agency_name_std=ALBEE MAPLE GROVE POLICE DEPARTMENT SAGINAW, service pop 2,656. https://albeetwp.com/township-services/ | https://wiki.radioreference.com/index.php/Saginaw_County_(MI) | https://policescorecard.org/mi/police-department/albee-twp-burt
reviewer_note: Genuine misresolution. The joint Albee-Maple Grove department serves two rural Saginaw County TOWNSHIPS; the current exclusive link to Saginaw city (pop20 44,202) is a county-name-to-largest-city autoroute off place_fips 70520 and is 16.8x the 2,656 service population. Because Albee township is already represented by its own ORI MI7392900, the half of the joint department with no jurisdiction is Maple Grove township, whose pop20 of 2,676 matches MI7355200's 2,656 service population to 0.7%, so routing MI7355200 to Maple Grove township both fixes the dilution and avoids double-covering Albee. CONFIDENCE MEDIUM and the reason is coverage, not geography: no official website, township page, state directory entry or news item for an active joint Albee-Maple Grove department exists on the open web (Albee Township's own site lists water, fire, trash and assessing but no police), the RadioReference Saginaw County roster shows two separate historical township unit designators rather than one combined agency, Police Scorecard's Albee entry has essentially no submitted data, and the Saginaw County Sheriff currently answers Albee Township crime under a contract that also covers Maple Grove and Jonesfield townships. If MI7355200 reports no counts the globally-dead-municipal-jurisdiction predicate will drop Maple Grove township back to the county remainder on its own, which is the correct behaviour. Alternative considered and rejected: reclassify_nonmunicipal, which would scatter the counts across the whole Saginaw County remainder instead of the one township that is actually unrepresented.

The 1,049 service population is the unincorporated Franklin-County township remainder (993 residents in the 2020 blocks), not Dublin's 49,328 - the flagged 47x dilution. SECOND, even if a township footprint were wanted it cannot be expressed here: this repo resolves city/township block overlap by smallest polygon, and because Dublin spans three counties its polygon is LARGER than the township's, so adding cousub 3904981242 would strip Dublin city to zero population and hand its 40,734 Franklin-County residents to the township. That is the inverse of the OH0151900 / Perry township case, where Salem city's polygon is smaller than the township's and the carve-out works. Routing to the Franklin County nonmunicipal remainder is therefore the only correct target.

reviewer_note: NO CHANGE: the flagged 2.1x is not dilution - the CDP under-covers the patrol area rather than over-covering it, and the service population is the artefact. Wintergreen Police Department is a Wintergreen Property Owners Association agency, established 1978, recognised as a Criminal Justice Agency in 1992 and as a Law Enforcement Agency under the Code of Virginia in 2015, VLEPSC-accredited since 2008, with officers appointed special deputies for Nelson County; it polices the Wintergreen community's Mountain and Stoney Creek sections, about 2,200 dwellings over roughly 17 square miles and 53+ miles of road, with no incorporated municipality anywhere in the picture. Wintergreen CDP 5187008 is the only 2020 TIGER geography for that community, it already straddles Nelson and Augusta counties exactly as the community does, and at 8.8 square miles it is SMALLER than the department's stated coverage, so it cannot be diluting the agency. The 346-versus-165 gap is a seasonal-community reporting artefact: WPOA reports about 3,600 properties and 3,800 owners against 346 census residents with a median age of 66, i.e. the community is overwhelmingly second homes, and 165 is a low or partial year-round figure. CONFIDENCE MEDIUM only because this is a private POA police force rather than a municipal department, so a future non-municipal or special-jurisdiction lane may be the better home; within the municipal lane the CDP is right.
